title: Velocity of rod cd
description: Essential: The final answer for part (1) is correctly given as v_t = mgR / (B²L²).

title: Electrical energy generated
description: Essential: The final answer for part (2) is correctly given as E_cd = (2m²g²Rt)/(B²L²) - (5m³g²R²)/(B⁴L⁴).

title: Maximum current in rod ab
description: Essential: The final answer for part (3) is correctly given as I_max = 2mg / (3BL).

title: Application of Newton's second law
description: Important: Correctly sets up force balance equations for both rods, including gravity, magnetic force, and acceleration.

title: Faraday's and Ohm's laws
description: Important: Correctly applies Faraday's law to find induced EMF and Ohm's law to find the circuit current.

title: System kinematics and constraint
description: Important: Recognizes and applies the condition that rod ab just leaves the posts at time t, linking the motion of the two rods.

title: Energy or impulse-momentum analysis
description: Optional: Uses an energy work theorem or impulse-momentum theorem to relate forces, motion, and the generated electrical energy.

title: Sign error in magnetic force
description: Pitfall: Incorrectly assigns the direction of the magnetic force on either rod, leading to wrong force equations.

title: Circuit resistance mistake
description: Pitfall: Uses an incorrect total circuit resistance (e.g., R instead of 2R) when applying Ohm's law.
